timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hi folks, my name is Brian DePice. I'm 46 years old. I live in a single film at home
with my wife Jennifer and two young boys Christopher and Nicholas. Christopher is six years old and
attends the first grade at the North Beverly Elementary School. Nicholas, we call Nicky, he
attends the intensive integrated preschool at the McEwan School and is four years old. I am a 1997
graduate of Northeastern University. I have a degree in accounting for community involvement.
I'm a member of the Beverly Rotary Club. I'm also a board of directors member at the Beverly
Children's Learn and Center located at 550 Cabot Street in Beverly. We are a preschool and after
school program for children under the age of 13. In my day job, I'm the principal of the mega group
which is a commercial real estate firm with a home office in Beverly and I specialize in retail
and investment real estate. We cover anywhere from Portland, Maine down to South Boston. I've
published a comprehensive list of challenges for the City of Beverly online and wanted to highlight
just a few for you today. I will be advocating for children with special needs and promoting
a fair public education. I will be advocating for seniors and affordable housing for seniors.
I will be advocating for a public safety of persons with disabilities and our law enforcement
personnel. But respect to new development in the community, I will be mindful of traffic and
the effect that new development has on our natural resources. With that, I'm asking for one of your
three votes for the Beverly City Council at large on November 7th of this year.
